throughput_source: SCENARIO ASSUMPTION: 32000 B/s is NOT measured Wi-Fi throughput. Sweep this parameter; do not present resulting coverage as a field measurement.
limitations: Awake devices at one indoor location. No distance, dense crowd, rain, Doze, group-owner reversal or adaptive discovery calibration. A contact lasts one simulation round; one peer per node; no simultaneous multi-hop. Contact probability, failure probability and gateway ratio remain assumptions from the selected config.
